rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Admiral Rodney
Exhibition name: Admiral Rodney
rows.Origin:
Bred by Cliff Trew (United Kingdom, 1973).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Warley Rose Gardens, Ltd. in 1973 as 'Admiral Rodney'.
Introduced by Unknown (Australia) in 1976 as 'Admiral Rodney'.
rows.Bloom: Rose-pink, darker reverse. Strong fragrance. Average diameter 4.25". Large, very full (41+ petals), exhibition bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Large, glossy foliage.

Height: 2' to 4¼' (60 to 130cm). Width: up to 2' (up to 60cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b through 9b (default). Vigorous. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
